description: This file defines an interface for a platform service related to credit report operations, including getting, saving, deleting, and uploading credit reports within the FinFireract project.

classes.name: CreditReportWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for handling credit report operations such as retrieval, storage, deletion, and uploading.

methods.name: getCreditReport
methods.description: Retrieves a credit report based on the provided command.

methods.name: saveCreditReport
methods.description: Saves a fetched credit report into the database associated with a specific organization credit bureau ID and national ID.

methods.name: deleteCreditReport
methods.description: Deletes a credit report from the database based on credit bureau ID and provided command.

methods.name: addCreditReport
methods.description: Uploads a credit report file to the credit bureau.
